format: JavaScript (with ES modules syntax and TypeScript integration)
description: This file is a script that analyzes TypeScript source code, specifically checking for proper usage of account ID properties and certain function calls related to channel pairing within a codebase. It imports utility modules and employs TypeScript's compiler API to parse and traverse source files, reporting violations indicative of code patterns not adhering to scoped account usage policies.

methods.name: hasRequiredAccountIdProperty
methods.description: Determines whether an object literal node includes a property named 'accountId' with a valid initializer.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Parses source content, traverses AST to find specific API usage violations related to account-scoped channel pairing.

methods.name: main
